SOL keeps the point that the name is scarcely known even in Nanman without needing the redundant creature label.
SOL keeps the three-power division and renders the cauldron image naturally.
SOL keeps the hornet’s-nest image and the point that searching the Grounds would not make the creature easy to spot.
SOL preserves both research actions and their meaning; the punctuation change does not alter the sense.
